edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
Constructor mints the total supply to msg.sender.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender in _approve.
enableTrading reads block.timestamp to set the launch time.
_launchTime is assigned from block.timestamp.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
_transfer compares block.timestamp to _launchTime to flag snipers.
_transfer uses tx.origin to index the transfer-delay mapping.
Timestamp equality check drives the sniper marking operation.
tx.origin is the key for the per-block purchase restriction.
The launch-time check writes _isSniper[to] = true.
The delay check writes _holderLastTransferTimestamp[tx.origin] = block.number.
_transfer reverts when _isSniper[from] is true.
_transfer executes fee arithmetic on buys and sells.
Fee arithmetic produces the fees local variable.
Computed fees are accumulated into _tokensForLiquidity.
buyTotalFees feeds the buy fee multiplication/division.
sellTotalFees feeds the sell fee multiplication/division.
_transfer calls swapBack when the contract balance exceeds swapTokensAtAmount.
_transfer compares contract token balance against swapTokensAtAmount.
swapBack calls _swapTokensForEth to convert tokens.
swapBack calls _addLiquidity with tokens and ETH.
_swapTokensForEth performs the router swap operation.
_addLiquidity performs the router addLiquidityETH operation.
The swap operation targets the trusted uniswapV2Router instance.
The liquidity operation targets the trusted uniswapV2Router instance.
External token/router swap can re-enter _transfer; only partially blocked by the _swapping flag.
External addLiquidityETH call happens while fee state is still mutable, allowing re-entrant _transfer.
withdrawFees executes the unrestricted balance transfer without any owner check.
The entire contract ETH balance is sent to the mutable feeWallet address.
updateFeeWallet reassigns the feeWallet used by withdrawFees.
newWallet parameter becomes the new feeWallet.
Constructor creates the Uniswap pair and stores it in uniswapV2Pair.
Constructor sets feeWallet = address(owner()).
Constructor performs the single _mint of the total supply.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint increases the recipient balance in _balances.
_transfer debits and credits _balances using SafeMath sub/add.
ERC20 transfer delegates to the overridden _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to the overridden _transfer.
transferFrom reads _allowances to decrease the spender allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to update the allowance.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
setSnipers writes _isSniper entries for the provided addresses.
delSnipers clears _isSniper entries.
snipers_ parameter entries are written into _isSniper.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the exclusion mapping.
excludeFromFees writes the fee-exclusion mapping.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the internal setter.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes automatedMarketMakerPairs.
updateBuyFees recomputes buyTotalFees from the three components.
updateSellFees recomputes sellTotalFees from the three components.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount.
newAmount parameter bounds are checked then stored in swapTokensAtAmount.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet.
from parameter indexes the _isSniper mapping check.
to parameter is the key written into _isSniper at launch.
amount parameter is the base value of the fee arithmetic.
contractTokenBalance local decides whether swapBack is invoked.
totalTokensToSwap local is a divisor in swapBack arithmetic.
liquidityTokens local is passed to _addLiquidity.
ethBalance local is split with mul/div into marketing/dev/liquidity shares.
limitsInEffect gates the anti-whale checks in _transfer.
transferDelayEnabled gates the tx.origin transfer-delay check.
_swapping guards swapBack invocation and fee taking in _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to index _isSniper and to be the debit account inside _transfer.
The to parameter is only used inside _transfer for sniper marking and balance checks.
The amount parameter is consumed directly by the fee mul/div computations.
newWallet is a transient argument that is immediately stored in feeWallet.
newAmount is a transient argument validated and assigned to swapTokensAtAmount.
The snipers_ array is only iterated to write into the _isSniper mapping.
contractTokenBalance is only used to decide whether swapBack executes.
fees is the direct output of the fee arithmetic and is forwarded to _tokensForLiquidity.
totalTokensToSwap is a temporary divisor created inside swapBack.
liquidityTokens exists solely to be passed as the token amount to addLiquidityETH.
ethBalance is a temporary value split arithmetically into marketing/dev/liquidity shares.
